name: Royal1155LDA amount-blind batch bookkeeping inflating a royalties claim 100x
summary: Royal1155LDA's _beforeTokenTransfer credits the recipient's per-tier balance one unit per ids entry, ignoring amounts, and skips the sender debit when its tier balance is zero and the backfill flag is unset. A batch transfer listing one LDA id a hundred times with zero amounts gave the attacker's helper a tier balance of 100 against supply 1, and Royalties paid it pro rata.
notes: Reset: the last proxy upgrade to the defective LDA implementation; the later minimum-deposit change on Royalties was not needed (the attacker deposited far more), and no Royalties USDC outflow before the exploit is anomalous.
Loss is the Royalties contract's USDC drop; the attacker's flash-loaned deposit into the tier in the same transaction is a round trip and is not counted.
